shortDescription: Manage BIG-IP Next instance files through CM

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the uploaded file as it should appear on the BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: device_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the BIG-IP Next instance to manage files on. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_ip).

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The ip address of the BIG-IP Next instance to manage files on. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_hostname).

options.name: filename
options.description: The path and filename of the file to be uploaded to BIG-IP Next instance.

options.name: force
options.description: When C(true), uploads the file every time and replaces the file on the BIG-IP Next instance. When C(false), the file is only uploaded if it does not already exist.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the file as it should appear on the BIG-IP Next instance. If not provided the parameter is inferred from C(filename).

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the file is uploaded. When C(absent), ensures the file is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the file to appear on BIG-IP Next instance. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
